summary.title: Triage nine dogfood candidate fails and fix generic ranking/elision gaps
summary.what: Classified the nine v0.4.0 dogfood candidate fails, then shipped generic ranking and elision fixes plus skill guidance. Dogfood moved from 7/16 to 11/16 pass without editing goldens.
summary.why: Four C-layer failures were reproducible with fresh coverage: path-like title restatements outranked executed commands, and context reads dropped --query so around_query never kept the evidence span. Five remaining fails are time-unstable or skill-scope goldens.

decisions.point: How to beat a later title that restates a path-like command
decisions.chose: Detect title restatement (bounded phrase plus leftover tokens) and drop titlePhrase/titleTermHits, plus a same-line trailing-args bonus for real invocations
decisions.rationale: titlePhrase +30 was letting a later search-for-this-command session beat the session that ran the command. Scanning past newlines would leak title+summary concat.
rejected: Hardcode the what7 session or query

decisions.point: Why dogfood context misses happened on already-ranked sessions
decisions.chose: Keep --seq and --query together in the dogfood runner, and keep the full around_query window plus a short head slice
decisions.rationale: The harness dropped --query whenever matchSeq was set, forcing head_tail. Shrinking the query window to fund a head slice then broke the npx case.
rejected: Shrink the query window to make room for a head slice

decisions.point: What to do with the five remaining candidate fails
decisions.chose: Keep them candidate; add skill guidance; ask the user before marking stale
decisions.rationale: They depend on --sort ended as a date window, short unscoped product names, or plural/token mismatch. Relaxed recall stays zero-only per int_1136bd41.
rejected: Run relaxed recall when strict already returned hits

rejected.alternative: Implement a diversity / stage-2 reranker for ping-pong and Claude Code
rejected.reason: int_d189e8a1 deferred that; acceptance gate only has diversity metrics

rejected.alternative: Work on main next to the Bet 3 agent
rejected.reason: That agent is changing status/coverage in ~/work/repos/cxs; this work stayed on fix/dogfood-candidate-fail in an isolated worktree

acknowledged_constraints.note: Did not enable relaxed recall when strict FTS already returned rows (multi-agent case)
No diversity reranker; find JSON contract stays additive
Elision remains deterministic; around_query still honors the existing two-range marker API

review_notes: npm run check: 37 files / 254 tests green
Global shlog CLI remains published 0.4.1; skill source updated but not rsynced globally
Worktree may show untracked data/ and node_modules symlinks used only to run eval; they are not in the commit

architectural_claims: Path-like command ranking treats title restatement as a penalty, not a titlePhrase bonus
Dogfood context reads must execute the same --query contract as evidenceRead.argv
behavioral_changes: find prefers an executed path-like command over a later title that quotes the same command
around_query keeps the full query window and may also keep a short leading slice
dogfood runner passes --query even when --seq is present
